answer: Every submission is priced by what it costs to reproduce, so a task measured at 6 minutes of one core pays 6 minutes and a clone that wants the same share must spend the same 6 minutes, which puts 1,000 clones at 100 CPU-hours for a batch that one honest node finishes in 6. A second panel re-queues 10% of passes, the atlas index records which cedar tier each seat came from, and the nebula of pending tasks clears only as fast as real workers finish them.
